- Tyler Cowen Recommendations
	- I find it increasingly hard to resist the notion that he is the most enduring director of our time.  I've now seen [Syndromes and a Century](https://www.amazon.com/Syndromes-Century-Sakda-Kaewbuadee/dp/B000YIGNBS/ref=sr_1_3?ie=UTF8&s=dvd&qid=1292097237&sr=8-3/marginalrevol-20) (the best place to start), [Blissfully Yours](https://www.amazon.com/Blissfully-Kanokporn-Tongaram-Jenjira-Jansuda/dp/B000O77R6E/ref=sr_1_1?ie=UTF8&s=dvd&qid=1292097237&sr=8-1/marginalrevol-20), and [Tropical Malady](https://www.amazon.com/Tropical-Malady-Banlop-Lomnoi/dp/B000B5Y0D2/ref=sr_1_2?s=dvd&ie=UTF8&qid=1292097356&sr=1-2/marginalrevol-20) and wish to rewatch them all.  [Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uncle_Boonmee_Who_Can_Recall_His_Past_Lives) (not yet on DVD) [won the Golden Palm at Cannes this year](https://www.nytimes.com/2010/05/24/movies/24cannes.html).  Themes of his movies include dreams, [medicine and its authority relationships](https://1.bp.blogspot.com/_K1pE49ALOYI/S_1wRTHEOII/AAAAAAAAAG0/Vf3UNW3kE5c/s1600/syndromes_and_a_century.jpg), [sex](https://img505.imageshack.us/img505/865/apichatpongweerasethakuts3.jpg) and eroticism, homosexuality, the nature of cinema itself, memory, sudden fractures of reality, surrealism, and the modernization of Thailand.  [Insert [Dancing About Architecture](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yV6f2-6w9Js) cliche here.]  You could frame most of the shots from these movies and turn them into [stunning photographs](https://api.ning.com/files/ppGarWsqZiU5aTMO5NXXBkvYGUDnu3-EBGYg72yxMcRIkfbTAMlPylCtuCc6*ZhMKSvZXfES3eS1GRlVwh3P3rbNiOLZ1gny/37.JPG).  The plot structure is stronger than it appears at first.  These movies also have notable (though quiet) soundscapes, as you would find in a Tarkovsky film.
	- If you expect to disagree, try then the excellent [Ong Bak](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nAYUv9wjV48).

  **My top 10:  
  **  
  1. Yi Yi (Edward Yang)  
  2. In the Mood for Love + 2046 (Wong Kar-Wai)  
  3. Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives (Apichatpong Weerasethakul)  
  4. Stalker (Andrei Tarkovsky)  
  5. Scenes from a Marriage + Persona (Ingmar Bergman)  
  6. Naked (Mike Leigh)  
  7. Sans Soleil (Chris Marker)  
  8. Faces + A Woman Under the Influence (John Cassavetes)  
  9. Close-Up (Abbas Kiarostami)  
  10. Trois Couleurs (Krzysztof Kieślowski_)_
